samples.question: Four ordered panels P1, P2, P3 and P4 are shown side by side, read left to right. Each panel shows the same horizontal track divided into six sites by thin tick marks, and a single red marker on one site. The red marker is the same token in every panel and it moves to a different site between each pair of consecutive panels. A reversal occurs when the marker's direction of horizontal travel changes sign: it moves right between two panels and then left between the next two (or left then right). Reading the four panels in order, how many times does the marker reverse its direction of travel across the whole sequence? Answer 0, 1, or 2.
